author: Insta360
description:
Turning 360 footage into enduring 3D archives. Introducing Project ETERNAL by Insta360 and Antigravity. We're on a mission to preserve the places that matter — capturing them from above with drone-powered 360 imaging and turning them into immersive 3D archives using Gaussian Splatting. 

Today with @CyArk, we're giving two legendary Italian sites a shot at eternity: the ancient ruins of Pompeii and the breathtaking hilltop village of Civita di Bagnoregio. From ancient iconic landscapes to personal spaces, we're capturing the past in detail so it can live on for generations to come. 

Learn more about Project ETERNAL 👉 https://bit.ly/Insta3603DGS
